references.name: Paper — Сегодня
references.prompt: Create one polished high-fidelity desktop WEB APPLICATION UI design reference, flat straight-on screen capture, 1536x1024 landscape composition, no laptop mockup, no perspective, no browser chrome, no watermark, no montage. This is a real product for learning active English vocabulary, working brand Recall. Adult, sophisticated, extremely legible interface, generous intentional spacing, refined custom typography, fine icons, realistic data, accessibility-conscious contrast. Russian interface labels with English learning examples. It should look like an exceptional product designer's finished Figma screen, with precise alignment, not a marketing landing page. DESIGN SYSTEM PAPER: warm ivory #F7F6F2 canvas, white surfaces, deep ink #20272B type, cobalt #3159D8 actions, warm-gray fine dividing rules. Editorial serif hero heading paired with clean contemporary sans for navigation, labels and body. Left narrow rail 208px with Recall wordmark and tiny solid cobalt square; navigation Сегодня active, Вспомнить, Разговор, Прогресс, Словарь. Bottom small profile Н / Никита. Main workspace split 70/30 without card-grid overload. Eyebrow ВТОРНИК, 27 ОКТЯБРЯ. Large serif heading «Слова, которые вы сможете сказать.» Subheading «15 минут практики на сегодня». Under it a large horizontal cobalt start button «Начать повторение →», beside small muted «12 слов к повторению». Below a very elegantly spaced three-step vertical lesson itinerary with outlined circle numbers 01,02,03: «Вспомнить» / «12 знакомых слов · 7 минут»; «Добавить новое» / «3 слова · 3 минуты»; «Поговорить» / «Планы на выходные · 5 минут». Right column is a slim editorial progress panel titled «Без подсказки», huge 7/10, supporting label «Проверка через 7 дней», simple thin-line 7-day trend chart in cobalt with meaningful dates, bottom «Следующая проверка — завтра». At bottom of main content a low-height full-width topic row with fine rules «Продолжить тему» and «Travel / Путешествия», small outlined arrow. Small top right discreet pill «Сегодня · 15 мин». Include one tasteful cropped abstract cobalt ink mark in the whitespace near the heading, very subtle and not a colorful illustration. Hierarchy, readability and calm focus are everything.
